scope: Existing source contracts and inspected execution records; proposed compositions retain their status.

operations.name: Extract a model brief from text and dimensions
prerequisites: Identify each value as supplied, measured, inferred, assumed, or calculated.
Declare units, origin, axes, component boundaries, intended output and source links.
changes_or_infers: Groups explicit requirements into named parameters and geometry constraints.
Does not infer hidden geometry from prose alone.
checks: Every numerical parameter has units and provenance.
Ambiguities affecting geometry are listed separately.
alternatives: Direct interactive OCS modeling after brief readback
Code-CAD generation from a validated brief
operations.summary: Create a source-linked brief before changing geometry; keep source claims separate from constraints and design choices.
operations.units_frames: Job length/angle units and named local/global frames are explicit inputs.
operations.metric_evidence: Source-labelled dimensions and unit/frame declarations are the metric inputs; the proposed brief check requires every numeric parameter to resolve to a source.
operations.handoff_conditions: Pass the named outputs, original source hashes, unit/frame record and operation check results to CAD-09, CAD-10. Preserve proposal/source status and reconcile any failed dimensional or frame checks before dependent use.
